cases.title: the slow-ship alarm measures how long the line has been still
cases.head: d5e91f2a0b7550635dcc8af73f9138db48f6e2dc

defects.title: Line head is picked with the sort comparator reversed
defects.why: The comment says the head is the lowest seq, but the swapped comparator makes the last ship in line the head, so with ships seq 1 and 5 waiting, the head string tracks seq 5 and the alarm names the wrong ship as first and misses the real head moving.

cases.title: fix-replay: a conflicting undo falls back to a partial one (-X ours)
cases.head: e0258353b681c379e4574356ab97deb9c74dcaa9

defects.title: The partial- prefix needs two conflicts instead of one
defects.why: When exactly one file conflicted and the -X ours fallback was used, pre is empty, so the outcome is reported as a plain red or applies instead of partial-red, hiding that the undo was only partial.

cases.title: a new minion's properties are checked before its row is made
cases.head: a7e6618b27214e724a9961b05a492bc966a12c76

defects.title: afterWrites is no longer awaited inside the try
defects.why: When afterWrites rejects, the failure is not caught here: the row is not deleted and no 500 is thrown, leaving an empty minion and an unhandled rejection, and the writes may not have finished when makeMinion returns.

cases.title: a cut-off install kills npm's whole process group; the sweep leaves the npm cache alone while an install runs
cases.head: aba057809c37f51a5847275f1669e1b35d27f246

defects.title: Cache sweep condition is inverted: empties it only while an install runs
defects.why: The comment says the cache is emptied when no install is reading it, but the dropped negation wipes it exactly while an install is running (breaking that install) and never when idle, so it stays over its cap.

cases.title: when_ci_passes waits are outbox rows (kind ci_armed)
cases.head: d84d6efd7439cf3ab397e6c0b42bdd1a0b62cfae

defects.title: merge condition is inverted for same-commit and new-commit arms
defects.why: The comment says a second arm on the same commit adds to the row and a new commit replaces it, but with the flipped test a same-sha re-arm replaces the payload (losing the earlier card or message) and a new sha merges old fields into it.

cases.title: a Taskmaster is woken for CI problems only overnight (shared wake)
cases.head: c56b8d97cea4e0960a539feabb1bd0386851f6fb

plant.from:
if (quietUntil(now) === null) {
      for (const x of ringing
plant.to:
if (quietUntil(now) !== null) {
      for (const x of ringing

defects.title: Per-scheme wake sent only during the overnight hold
defects.why: wakeFor tests quietUntil(now) !== null, so a problem wakes its Taskmaster only inside the 2-9 AM hold and never during the day; wakeShared still uses === null, so the two disagree.

cases.title: back to green also comes from a push or merge run on main
cases.head: bfb7fcb32dafd5bc3729634812a7c405c1c95dd8

defects.title: Back to green picks green runs older than the red one
defects.why: The filter keeps green runs created before the red run instead of after it, so the first poll after a red reports "back to green" from an old run while the workflow is still red.

cases.title: semantic memory skips refused chunks and reads ticket texts in pages
cases.head: dc89ca351d5fc6e9a1b3217b2b98c8f90ae451d7

defects.title: loadTicketTexts is not awaited before pendingTickets
defects.why: loadTicketTexts yields between pages and sets ticketTexts only at the end, so pendingTickets runs with the map still null, sees an empty index and queues every ticket for re-embedding on the first pass.

cases.title: the wording check flags <stand-in> placeholders in shell command blocks
cases.head: f7f4e3a5a1e4bb73f629444e8b387059bd776fe4

defects.title: Secret stand-in exempt only when every word is a secret word
defects.why: With every, a multi-word secret like <api token> or <my-password> is flagged as a placeholder because "api" or "my" is not a secret word; the commit says a stand-in with one of these words is allowed.

cases.title: a schedule slot cut off by a kill finishes with its minion
cases.head: e41726ee7d2d998258125bef9773ba752266a1bc

plant.from: AND created_at >= ? AND id IS NOT ?
plant.to: AND created_at <= ? AND id IS NOT ?

defects.title: cutOff matches minions made before the slot came due
defects.why: created_at <= next_run_at selects the schedule's oldest earlier minion instead of one made since the slot came due, so every normal slot finishes (or marks ran) an old minion and never starts a new run.

cases.title: surface plugin_errors and mcp_server_errors from a turn's init in the chat and the minion's note
cases.head: aefe3b7d50fcf8fcf68b7b534e3449100970fa95

defects.title: A single plugin or MCP load error is ignored
defects.why: checkLoadErrors returns early when there is exactly one error line, so a turn with one failed plugin shows no chat error and no note, though the comment says any failed load is reported.

cases.title: a merged branch keeps its artifacts; two boots at once can't pass the preview cap
cases.head: a59a994df69b230fa845c522915aa4c4a27a7218

defects.title: booting key never removed when a boot ends
defects.why: The finally clears `starting` but not `booting`, so each finished or failed boot keeps its slot counted against max: after max boots the cap loop waits on booting forever (or halts previews needlessly).

cases.title: a red train whose real failure also fails on main's tip refuses no rider
cases.head: bd1b55f603d4f77c199a0bff5e5dc8619f107072

defects.title: retry_in_place condition inverted
defects.why: The retry in place is meant for riders going back in line (the comment says alone, a retry would only run CI again), but the test is flipped: a ship alone gets a pointless retry and a train with riders gets none.

cases.title: review_set MCP tool for reading the set and saving a critic's learning
cases.head: ebfd9a5d1f1f943b75a4d79e400c4cfc3cf1adef

defects.title: PATCH result not awaited in review_set save
defects.why: e is a Promise, so the tool replies 'Saved undefined as version undefined.' and a refused save (stale version) is never thrown to the minion.

cases.title: uncommitted work in a minion's worktree takes its live badge back to its branch
cases.head: a3806ba8983429fea5c1c2cd48dc9d2f9ee84464

defects.title: uncommittedFiles not awaited
defects.why: uncommitted holds a Promise: truthy for any minion with a worktree, so every branch shows 'changes not committed yet', and JSON.stringify of it gives {}.

cases.title: Stop-hook finding: a choice asked in prose with no card this turn
cases.head: a9c31256a5a1f77af1dc9092bcfc18b3c83e6511

defects.title: tail takes the first two paragraphs, not the last two
defects.why: The doc says the last two paragraphs are checked, but slice(0, 2) takes the first two: a choice asked in the closing paragraph of a reply with 3 or more paragraphs is never flagged, and one in the opening paragraphs is.

cases.title: CI problems that ring wake their scheme's Taskmaster once
cases.head: b6e06490fa1c5be65ac3ff1179cc5cab87285d54

plant.to: if (p) await this.deliver(p, w.problems.filter((x) => x.quiet), w as Required<LandWatch>);

defects.title: land gate path never calls wakeFor
defects.why: The header comment says the land gate wakes the live checkout's scheme too, but only check() calls wakeFor: when the land gate opens a ringing problem, no Taskmaster is woken, and Citadel's bundle no longer wakes either.

cases.title: one classifier for links: a framed app's own links stay in it, citadel.zip stays in Citadel
cases.head: c29bdf909eced0b4c837ed2cec640ae4a0652854

defects.title: app link test flipped: only the page's own app opens in the app view
defects.why: The comment says another app's link opens in the app view and the page's own stays; with === a link to another app falls through to firefox/browser handling, and a link to the framed app itself is sent up to Citadel instead of staying in the frame.

cases.title: a fenced block tagged with where it runs gets a coloured header
cases.head: 34b14909c9d28e0ef8d7f84b68cb2fec681fd58d

defects.title: Fence info string put into the class attribute without escaping
defects.why: The info string (m[2]) is any non-space, non-backtick text, so a fence tagged ```x"onmouseover="alert(1) breaks out of the class attribute and injects markup, while the neighbouring data-label and the code body are escaped.

cases.title: an app turn cut off by a restart ends interrupted with one retry
cases.head: 0c3a233cf7a6f9fc425ab10bde9b55e1ed6a2003

defects.title: Error notice message inserted into HTML without esc
defects.why: The error block's message comes from the turn's event stream and is rendered into the notice template unescaped, while RETRY_SAY in the same template goes through esc; a message containing < or & renders as markup.

cases.title: heavy-unit scopes get a TMPDIR on disk; sweep removes orphaned scratch
cases.head: 4e0a97767aa6044f623f57ecde838eaa377dc937

defects.title: Scratch dir path written into the job shell script unquoted
defects.why: tmp is joined from the job dir and written into a shell script; without quote() a dir path containing a space or shell metacharacter splits or runs as commands, where the other exported values are quoted.

cases.title: MA5: run_task names the commit it ran and refuses a caller whose own git_sync another minion has since moved
cases.head: af488ac43e894c8798b931172c38046d308d9b0d

plant.from: You checked out ${mine.sha.slice(0, 10)}; it is now at ${commit.slice(0, 10)}
plant.to: You checked out ${commit.slice(0, 10)}; it is now at ${mine.sha.slice(0, 10)}

defects.title: Refusal message swaps the synced commit and the current commit
defects.why: The text says "You checked out" the workspace head and "it is now at" the caller's own synced sha, so the two commits are reversed: a caller who synced A when the workspace moved to B is told they checked out B.

cases.title: waits released by a proven plan resume 5 s apart, not 30 s (an unproven wait no longer holds a proven one back); the limit notes say Pacific
cases.head: e9ed3f7bc3622e6147c3530f7dce709df5e26fd0

cases.title: blind contraption turns: neutral folder, the app's text as the whole system prompt, no machines, no Codex, always fresh; api.md says so and
cases.head: c0eba43f9f3597d867fcc43c22caf6d7c14f88c3

cases.title: ship notes and new messages read through partial indexes; settingsWithPrefix reads a key range
cases.head: af94b0d503af38b5f934432218ae9965d616d060

cases.title: citadel-test's time limit signals only node's runner; its test fires the limit once the hung test runs
cases.head: c1b866a43b26c41bd4f2993d17b9fbe336955e74

cases.title: Status page Jobs tile lists every periodic job, flagging overdue (3 periods), slow (>1 s) and failed ones
cases.head: a49185c7a5160d56d7a154f796c46880efd281b9
